newsitem.title: USA: Specialty Tele to redeem warrants.
newsitem.headline: Specialty Tele to redeem warrants.

text.p: Specialty Teleconstructors Inc Thursday said it notified holders of its redeemable common stock purchase warrants, that it intends to redeem all outstanding warrants on March 26, 1997.
Holders of the warrants may exercise the warrants until March 25, 1997.
Specialty Teleconstructors is dedicated primarily to the build-out and maintenance of wireless communications transmitting and receiving facilities for providers of wireless communication services
